# Day AI | Product Overview

Day AI is a “customer memory layer” for AI agents that automatically collects email, meeting, and collaboration contexts and can co-exist with existing CRMs. The product core creates a unified workspace around customer relationships, sales execution and revenue processes, reducing dispersed tools and manual maintenance.
